{{Youmay|the general type of torpedo|a [[Homing proton torpedo|specific upgrade]] for [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]}}
[[File:Homing_torpedo.jpg|250px|thumb|Homing torpedo launched from [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem's]] ship.]]

'''Homing torpedoes''' were small projectile missiles, with a bigger warhead replaced with a guiding system. It made homing torpedoes less dangerous, but more maneuverable.

They were very useful on slow [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] found the homing torpedo upgrade for his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', released in [[2000]], players may upgrade their proton torpedoes by finding an upgrade in the [[Attack on Porso Hill|''Borvo the Hutt'']] mission. As acquiring the upgrade is necessary for 100% game completion, this article assumes the player did so.
